description: This file defines the IdleFrameProcessor class, which monitors frame activity in a processing pipeline and triggers a callback if no frames are received within a specified timeout. It handles asynchronous operations, interacts with frame objects, and extends functionality from a parent FrameProcessor class.

classes.name: IdleFrameProcessor
classes.description: A processor that monitors for frame activity and executes a callback when no frames are received within a specified timeout period.

methods.name: __init__( self, *, callback: Callable[["IdleFrameProcessor"], Awaitable[None]], timeout: float, types: Optional[List[type]] = None, **kwargs, )
methods.description: Initializes the IdleFrameProcessor with a callback, timeout, frame types to monitor, and optional additional arguments.

methods.name: process_frame(self, frame: Frame, direction: FrameDirection)
methods.description: Processes incoming frames, updates idle timeout monitoring, and triggers callback if conditions are met.

methods.name: cleanup(self)
methods.description: Cleans up resources and cancels pending idle timeout tasks.

methods.name: _create_idle_task(self)
methods.description: Creates and starts the asynchronous task responsible for monitoring idle timeout.

methods.name: _idle_task_handler(self)
methods.description: Handles waiting for the idle event with timeout and executes the callback if timeout occurs.
